g.text: Offline frontier; 100–1000 epochs = 5–50 s. Quality lines require all 1000 common epochs; open points
show partial intervals or censored Pareto estimates, labelled n. Bubbles use sampled RSS, not the unknown
true peak. No extrapolation; replay changes with LF.
